brand.name: Yosia
home.hero.lead: Yosia is a local-first app designed to help people quit cigarettes, vaping, and nicotine dependence. It organizes intervention, analysis, insight, and motivation into one coherent recovery path.
home.hero.hint: The button will route to the right store for your device.
home.map.title: Your path to recovery is more than logging
home.path.guide.title: Personalized Onboarding
home.path.guide.body: Start from goal type and personal profile to build a recovery path that fits the individual.
home.path.log.title: Logging
home.path.log.body: Capture cravings, slips, and recovery states continuously so later analysis is grounded in real behavior.
home.path.sos.title: SOS Intervention
home.path.sos.body: In the hardest moments, stabilize first through breathing guidance and low-friction actions.
home.path.analysis.title: Analysis and Insights
home.path.analysis.body: Turn records into high-risk windows, trigger patterns, streaks, and clearer behavioral trends.
home.path.badges.title: Badges and Achievements
home.path.badges.body: Milestone feedback makes effort visible and helps users keep moving with stronger motivation.
home.path.share.title: Social Sharing
home.path.share.body: Your progress deserves to be seen. Turn trends, milestones, and outcomes into expressive share cards.
home.modules.sos.title: In the hardest moments, give users one action they can take immediately
home.modules.sos.body: The SOS module is designed around breathing guidance, delay intervention, and low-friction interaction so users can reduce the sense of losing control first, then return to recovery rhythm.
home.modules.guide.title: Not one-size-fits-all, but a recovery plan shaped by your own baseline
home.modules.guide.body: Yosia supports cigarettes, nicotine, and vaping management, including different vape types. The app uses your personal baseline and goals to provide more targeted guidance and recovery paths instead of a generic template.
home.modules.guide.cardBody: Build the recovery plan from goal type and starting profile, including cigarettes, vaping, and nicotine substitutes.
home.modules.history.cardBody: Turn scattered logs into high-risk windows, trigger patterns, and clearer understanding of behavior.
home.modules.badges.cardBody: Unlockable badges and milestone feedback keep effort visible and motivation active.
home.modules.insights.title: Turn recovery progress into clear, revisit-worthy trends
home.modules.insights.body: Streaks, savings, reduction, and behavior trends make progress visible instead of abstract.
home.modules.share.title: Turn recovery progress into expressive share cards
home.modules.share.body: Trends, overview snapshots, and achievements can be shaped into polished visual cards for sharing or self-reflection. Your persistence is visible.
home.modules.medal.title: Turn every moment of persistence into visible progress
home.modules.medal.body: From streaks to key milestones, Yosia turns effort into trackable medals and stage achievements, so motivation comes from progress you can actually see.
home.modules.language.title: A natural experience across different language environments
home.modules.language.body: We may speak different languages, but we share the same goal: break free from dependence.
home.modules.privacy.title: Your recovery data never leaves your device
home.modules.privacy.body: Yosia follows a local-first data strategy. Plans, logs, metrics, and insights stay on the device by default, work offline, and do not depend on cloud custody.
home.modules.privacy.points.oneBody: Core recovery data is processed and stored on your device by default.
home.modules.privacy.points.twoBody: We do not maintain a hosted cloud database for your recovery history.
home.modules.privacy.points.threeBody: You keep stronger privacy control, but data cannot be restored by us after uninstall.
home.footer.copy: A local-first recovery support tool for cigarettes, vaping, and nicotine dependence.

privacy.hero.title: Your recovery data belongs to you by default
privacy.hero.lead: Yosia is a local app. Except for the minimum information handled by app stores, payment systems, or legal requirements, we do not store your personal recovery records on our own servers.
privacy.sections.local.title: 1. Local storage by default
privacy.sections.local.body: Nicknames, quit plans, craving logs, slip logs, SOS sessions, statistics, and insights created inside the app are stored locally on your device by default.
privacy.sections.server.title: 2. We do not store your recovery data
privacy.sections.server.body: We do not upload that recovery data to our own servers, and we do not maintain a cloud database that hosts your personal history for you.
privacy.sections.offline.title: 3. Offline use is supported
privacy.sections.offline.body: Because core data remains local, the app can continue to record, display, and manage your recovery information even without network access.
privacy.sections.control.title: 4. Control stays with you
privacy.sections.control.body: You directly control the data on your device. Keeping the app, removing it, or clearing local app data will directly affect whether that data continues to exist.
privacy.sections.loss.title: 5. Uninstall means irreversible loss
privacy.sections.loss.body: Because we prioritize strict privacy protection and a local-first model, uninstalling the app, clearing app data, factory resetting your device, or switching devices without migration may permanently erase the data. We cannot restore it from our servers.
privacy.sections.liability.title: 6. Responsibility for data loss
privacy.sections.liability.body: We are not responsible for restoring or compensating for data lost due to app uninstall, local data deletion, device damage, system reset, lost devices, or any other cause outside our control. Please decide whether to use Yosia with a clear understanding of its local-storage nature.
privacy.sections.accept.title: 7. Continued use means acceptance
privacy.sections.accept.body: By downloading, installing, or continuing to use Yosia, you acknowledge and accept this local-first privacy model and the fact that data cannot be recovered from our servers.
